```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : 6 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
  constructor
  · -- Prove 2 divides the product
    have h2 : 2 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) :=
      dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_two (2 : ℕ)) (dvd_two (2 : ℕ))) (dvd_two (2 : ℕ))
    exact h2
  · -- Prove 3 divides the product
    have h3 : 3 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) :=
      dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_three (3 : ℕ)) (dvd_three (3 : ℕ))) (dvd_three (3 : ℕ))
    exact h3
```
